title: ReSFlow: Rectifying Categorical Flows on Statistical Manifolds for One-Step Generation
abstract_first: Generative modeling for discrete data has been significantly advanced by learning continuous vector fields on the statistical manifolds to transport simple priors to target discrete distributions.
